title: Don't Guess, Ask Wisely: Benchmarking and Training Proactive Elicitation in Open-Domain LLM Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.01878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When user queries are incomplete, large language models should ask targeted questions before committing to an answer, a capability we call proactive elicitation, yet evaluation on real user-assistant queries across seven LLMs (8B to frontier) shows that fewer than 11% of underspecified queries trigger a follow-up question. To benchmark and train this capability, we introduce VagueBench, where each seed query is annotated with structured intent and detail units then degraded into intent-vague and fully-vague variants via controlled removal of linguistic cues, yielding known hidden information sets for evaluating both when and what to ask. We propose DialogGRPO, an offline reinforcement learning method that organizes multi-turn elicitation as a dialogue-state directed acyclic graph, where candidate questions at each node receive dense turn-level rewards combining immediate information gain with lookahead value through group-relative compar

translated_title: 不要猜测，明智地提问：开放域大语言模型对话中主动询问能力的基准测试与训练
translated_abstract: 当用户查询不完整时，大语言模型应该在给出最终答案之前提出有针对性的问题，我们将这种能力称为主动询问。然而，对七个大语言模型（从8B到前沿模型）在真实用户-助手查询上的评估显示，仅有不到11%的欠规范查询触发了后续提问。为了对这一能力进行基准测试和训练，我们提出了VagueBench，其中每个种子查询都被标注了结构化的意图和细节单元，然后通过有控制地移除语言线索，将其降级为意图模糊和完全模糊的变体，从而生成已知的隐藏信息集合，用于评估何时提问以及提问什么。我们进一步提出了DialogGRPO，这是一种离线强化学习方法，它将多轮询问过程组织为对话状态有向无环图，其中每个节点上的候选问题获得密集的轮次级奖励，该奖励通过组相对比较将即时信息增益与前瞻价值相结合……
tldr: 本文提出VagueBench基准数据集与DialogGRPO离线强化学习方法，通过将多轮询问建模为对话状态有向无环图并结合即时信息增益与前瞻价值的密集轮次级奖励，训练大语言模型在面对模糊查询时主动提出有针对性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VagueBench and DialogGRPO, an offline reinforcement learning method that organizes multi-turn elicitation as a dialogue-state directed acyclic graph with dense turn-level rewards combining immediate information gain and lookahead value, enabling LLMs to proactively ask targeted questions when facing underspecified queries.
